name: @comfyui/cordis
description: The comfyui engine's Cordis compose plane + models registry (merged 2026-09-08: the models plane folds in — one package, two services ctx.models + ctx.comfyui). Runtime is node --experimental-strip-types (erasable-syntax TS); no build step. Cards are one-folder units (card-folder-shape design record): card.ts (host face) + ui/ (browser face — deps below exist for the studios' module resolution; the editor's vite/vitest compiles them, the engine tsc program excludes ui/) + agents/ (model context, served by the planes door).
